disturbed.description: How much people, fire or fresh ground have opened it, 0 to 1.

forage.description: What it offers animals that feed there (`FORAGE`).

notes.description: One sentence on what the entry is, for people and the catalogue.

open.description:
How open the ground is to the sky and to running animals, 0 (closed
wood) to 1 (open plain).

rock.description: How much of the ground is stone, 0 to 1.

shade.description: Share of the ground under a canopy, 0 to 1.

soil.description: Acid (0) to base-rich (1), as a biome's `soil`.

wet.description:
Ground water, 0 dry to 1 standing water: the habitat's baseline for
the `wet` site field.
